messages:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — nightly kernel-harness sweep flagged a perf regression for a candidate kernel on AVX2 at seqlen=2048. numbers diverge after ~1200 iters. cc @kevin @jia :eyes:

Maria Chen: summary snippet:
```
benchmark: kernel-cand-7a
hw: c6i.metal (AVX2)
seqlen: 2048
batch: 1
metric: p50 latency
previous: 23.4ms
current: 34.1ms (+45%)
throughput: 9.1 -> 6.2 tokens/ms
notes: regression starts around iter ~1200, not present at seqlen=1024
```

Kevin Park: ack — can you paste the exact harness cmd & run id so i can repro locally? Also any perf counter dumps you have would help.

Kevin Park: repro command I used locally (to reproduce your run):
```
./harness/run_microbench --kernel kernel-cand-7a --arch x86-avx2 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --iters 2500 --run-id harness-20260310-42
```

Kevin Park: quick note — i see similar p50 jump when i force `--cpu-preset=aggressive` which toggles a different vectorized path. attaching brief perf stat: `cycles:u  1.6e9  -> 2.3e9` and `L1-dcache-load-misses` increase ~3x.

Jia Li: thanks. my hunch: branch/selector in kernel dispatch is picking the fallback slow path after a certain sequence window (maybe due to loop-peeling or alignment changes). plus KV-cache "heat" could amplify it (cold vs warmed caches behave differently).

Jia Li: quick experiments to add to harness: compare cold vs warmed KV cache and force kernel selection to verify selector behavior:
```
# cold cache
./harness/run_microbench --kernel kernel-cand-7a --arch x86-avx2 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --kv-warm 0 --iters 1500
# warmed cache
./harness/run_microbench --kernel kernel-cand-7a --arch x86-avx2 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --kv-warm 1 --iters 1500
```

Oliver Gomez: fwiw we recently added a small probe for batch sweep on other kernels — can adapt here. propose: sweep batch 1..8 and seq pivot points [512,1024,1536,2048,4096] and record which kernel variant was chosen per-step (so we can see selector flips).

Oliver Gomez: example probe output (tabular-ish):
```
step,seq,batch,chosen_kernel
100,1024,1,kernel-2f
850,1536,1,kernel-2f
1205,2048,1,kernel-cand-7a -> kernel-fallback-3 (flip at 1205)
```

Maria Chen: good plan. i also captured a tiny flamegraph clip when it regressed — attaching snippet inline: `hot spin in scalar_loop()` — suggests vector lanes are not being used after the flip.

sre-bot: CI update — nightly-harness sweep #6543 completed. link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/nightly-harness/6543 (artifacts: harness-20260310-42, perf-stats.tar.gz) :white_check_mark:

Kevin Park: i'll run targeted microprobe + perf stat with `--cpu-preset=conservative` and `aggressive` to see if codegen toggles it. also will collect `perf record` + `annotate`. tagging @oliver for probe changes.

Oliver Gomez: will add kernel-selection counter and batch/seq sweep to the harness job, and push a quick patch to the autotuner to stop selecting kernel-cand-7a for AVX2 on seqlen>1024 until we root cause.

Maria Chen: +1 to temp-gate. opened tracking issue #927 (kernel-cand-7a AVX2 regression). I'll add the perf artifacts and the harness commands there. action items: (1) kevin run perf + repro, (2) oliver add selector counter probe, (3) jia add kv-warm tests, (4) gate candidate in autotuner until fix.

Jia Li: sounds good. small follow-up — also check quantization/unaligned-load patches in last week; those touched the same selection predicate.

Maria Chen: noted, i'll bisect the last autotune commit range after kevin's perf dump.

sre-bot: rerun triggered: nightly-harness/smoke-probe updated with selector-counter (run id harness-20260310-43) - queued on c6i.metal.

Maria Chen: thanks team — keep updates concise here and drop links to PRs/issues in the thread. :rocket:
